title: Async commit can return txn-too-old error and later recover as committed

rationale: The selector enumerates ordinary-error edges after the async recovery proof horizon.
The oracle compares client terminal classification with independent resolver and MVCC truth.
The aged transaction and unavailable cleanup make the late guard product-relevant.
The fault preserves real prewrite and recovery while controlling guard and compensation altitude.
The schedule crosses proof, late error, and independent recovery owners in order.
The client-go committer and lock resolver jointly own the terminal truth contract.
